title: GTIN product Markdown input
description: Look up GTIN / UPC / EAN barcodes through UPCitemdb or Barcode Lookup (bring your own API key) with Open Food Facts as a keyless food/FMCG fallback. Every successful product card is charged; not-found and failed rows are free.

gtins.title: GTINs / UPCs / EANs
gtins.description: One barcode per line (8–14 digits). Spaces and dashes are stripped; non-digit characters are removed. Duplicates are dropped.

barcodes.title: Barcodes (alias of gtins)
barcodes.description: Optional alias of `gtins`. Same normalization rules.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID (barcode list)
datasetId.description: Optional. Read barcodes from another Actor's dataset. Uses the field set in 'Barcode field', else gtin / upc / ean / barcode / code.

keyValueStoreId.title: Key-value store ID (barcode list)
keyValueStoreId.description: Optional. Read barcodes from a key-value record: JSON array, {"gtins": [...]} / {"barcodes": [...]}, or plain text with one barcode per line.

keyValueRecordKey.title: Key-value record key
keyValueRecordKey.description: Record key inside the key-value store (default INPUT_GTINS).

barcodeField.title: Barcode field (dataset / JSON objects)
barcodeField.description: Optional. Name of the field holding the barcode in dataset items or JSON objects.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which barcode API to call. `auto` uses your key with UPCitemdb first (then Barcode Lookup on auth failure), then Open Food Facts on miss when fallback is on. Without a key, `auto` goes straight to Open Food Facts.
enumTitles: Barcode Lookup only (+ optional OFF fallback)

apiKey.title: Provider API key
apiKey.description: UPCitemdb paid `user_key` or Barcode Lookup `key`. Stored encrypted and never logged. Without a key, paid providers are skipped; Open Food Facts still works when fallback is enabled. Placeholders like YOUR_KEY are ignored.

upcitemdbUserId.title: UPCitemdb user_key override (optional)
upcitemdbUserId.description: Rarely needed. UPCitemdb paid plans authenticate with the `user_key` header (same value as apiKey) plus fixed `key_type: 3scale`. Use this only if you want a separate user_key distinct from apiKey.

fallbackOpenFoodFacts.title: Fallback to Open Food Facts
fallbackOpenFoodFacts.description: When the paid provider misses (or no key is provided under auto), look up the GTIN on Open Food Facts (keyless, food/FMCG coverage). Always labels `source=openfoodfacts` on success.

includeRagChunks.title: Include RAG chunks
includeRagChunks.description: Split each product Markdown card into ~500–800 character chunks with headings. Written to key-value record CHUNKS.jsonl.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many barcodes. 0 = no limit (still subject to platform limits).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel provider requests. Keep low to respect provider rate limits.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for 429, 5xx and timeouts with exponential backoff (honours Retry-After). 401/403/not-found are not retried.

stopOnAuthError.title: Stop on rejected key
stopOnAuthError.description: After a paid provider rejects the key (401/403), mark remaining paid lookups as skipped (still try Open Food Facts when fallback is on). All free.
